scenes.name: Acoustic Guitars & Campus Bell
scenes.subtitle: Borrowed notes & morning sunlight • The corridor chatter begins

scenes.name: Life Beyond the Lecture Hall
scenes.subtitle: What was lived outside the classroom walls • The real education of youth

lines.text: Class ke baad jo zindagi thi, woh class mein kahan milti thi,
Ek bench pe chhoti duniya thi, har baat nayi si lagti thi.

scenes.name: Unwritten Notes & Golden Dreams
scenes.subtitle: Notes left incomplete, dreams running deep • What matters is today

lines.text: Notes adhoore, sapne poore, aankhon mein shehar basaaya tha,
Kal ka kya hai, aaj doston ne, hans ke humein sikhaaya tha.

scenes.name: The Timeless Chorus
scenes.subtitle: Class ke baad jo zindagi thi • An echo that never fades

lines.text: Class ke baad jo zindagi thi, woh class mein kahan milti thi,

scenes.name: Morning Bus & Half-Opened Bags
scenes.subtitle: Fighting sleep on the morning ride • At the campus gate the day was ours

lines.text: Subah ki bus mein neend sambhaale, bag bhi aadha khula tha,
Gate pe milte hi lagta tha, din apna hi likha tha.

scenes.name: Roll Call Proxies & Shared Tiffin Feast
scenes.subtitle: Answering attendance for missing friends • One lunchbox split four ways

lines.text: Roll call mein naam pukara, kisi ne 'present' keh diya,
Ek tiffin ke chaar hisse the, bhookh ka bhi fest kar diya.

scenes.name: Canteen Udhaar & Cherished Bonds
scenes.subtitle: Chai on credit ledger • Friendships that mattered more than any deadline

lines.text: Canteen ki udhaar wali chai, kitni mehengi aur kitni bani,
Assignment ki deadline se zyada, dosti humko khaas lagi.

scenes.name: One Bench, Incomplete Notes & Whole Dreams
scenes.subtitle: Building entire cities in our eyes • Laughter that taught us to live today

lines.text: Class ke baad jo zindagi thi, woh class mein kahan milti thi,
Ek bench pe chhoti duniya thi, har baat nayi si lagti thi.
Notes adhoore, sapne poore, aankhon mein shehar basaaya tha,
Kal ka kya hai, aaj doston ne, hans ke humein sikhaaya tha.

scenes.name: Acoustic Solo & Hallway Breeze
scenes.subtitle: Sunlight drifting across vacant benches • Memories in the making

scenes.name: Hostel Rooftops & Midnight Ambitions
scenes.subtitle: Startups, music, or going back home • Talking under 3 AM stars

lines.text: Hostel ki chhat pe teen baje, future par behas chali,
Koi startup, koi music, koi ghar lautne ki baat chali.

scenes.name: Laughing at Marks & Celebrating Together
scenes.subtitle: Failing together meant no one cried • One person's win was everyone's festival

lines.text: Fail hue toh saath baithkar, marks ko humne hasa diya,
Jeet kisi ek ki hoti thi, par poore group ne mana diya.

scenes.name: Learning Selfhood Before Degrees
scenes.subtitle: Falling and rising up together • Hands reaching out without asking

lines.text: Degree ke pannon se pehle, hum khud ko padhna seekh gaye,
Gir kar uthna, haath badhana, ek duje se seekh gaye.

scenes.name: Empty Timetables & Echoes in the Frame
scenes.subtitle: Different cities tomorrow • But the campus forever walks with us

lines.text: Ek din yeh corridor khaali, aur yeh timetable puraana hoga,
Jo roz milte the bina bulaaye, unse milna bahaana hoga.
Par photo mein jo shor bacha hai, woh kabhi kam nahi hoga,
Hum alag shehron mein honge, par apna campus saath hoga.

scenes.name: Echoes of Friends & Meeting in Memories
scenes.subtitle: Even if the final bell rings out • We will meet again inside our memories

lines.text: Class ke baad jo zindagi thi, woh class mein kahan milti thi,
Har dost ki ek aawaaz mein, apni hi dhadkan chalti thi.
Notes adhoore, sapne poore, raaste naye banayenge,
Ghanti baj kar keh bhi de toh, yaadon mein phir mil jayenge.

scenes.name: Class Ke Baad Jo Zindagi Thi
scenes.subtitle: The campus bell fades into silence • The friendship remains forever alive

lines.text: Class ke baad jo zindagi thi...
Woh class mein kahan milti thi...
Woh class mein kahan milti thi...
